assessment: The paper addresses the highly timely question of how to quantify aperiodic and periodic neural activity. This was done by extending previous work by embracing time-resolved parametrization of both simulated, noninvasive EEG and intracranial data. The new approach is termed Spectral Parametrization Resolved in Time (SPRiNT) and the paper shows that the slope of aperiodic activity is linked with both behavior and age. The method thus demonstrates the importance of evaluating the state-dependence of aperiodic activity and dynamic properties of oscillatory components in a time-resolved manner, and we believe that this approach would be of great interest to researchers analyzing human electrophysiological data to address clinical and cognitive neuroscience questions.
